blindSummary: Bans gender-affirming medical care for minors (a 2023 law in force since 28 August 2023 after a judge declined to block it) and restricts access to such treatment for people in prisons, jails and correctional centres, with providers facing licence revocation; no adult facility ban recorded.
blindSourceSummaries: A national public-broadcaster report (29 August 2023, filed from the state/province's largest city): a judge denied a preliminary injunction against this state/province's ban on gender-affirming medical care for minors, so the minors-care ban law took effect 28 August 2023 - prohibiting hormones/puberty blockers for under-18s (unless already in treatment) and all transition-related surgeries for minors; the law also bars federal health-coverage reimbursement, restricts treatment access in prisons, jails and correctional centres, exposes violating providers to licence revocation, and sunsets in 2027 after a bipartisan concession; plaintiffs (the state's civil-liberties union, an LGBTQ legal-aid organisation and others) continue toward trial on the merits.
blindLocalsOnly: The minors-care ban, the health-coverage exclusion and the 2027 sunset bind residents and their providers; a visitor's exposure is the institutional posture they signal, not these mechanisms.
